db_backend.title: Db Backend
db_backend.description: Database backend to use (e.g. sqlite, postgres, mssql).

db_password.title: Db Password
db_password.description: Plaintext password; encrypted before being persisted.

instances.title: Instances
instances.description: Number of archiver instances to run.

retention_days.title: Retention Days
retention_days.description: Number of days to retain logs before purge, or None to retain indefinitely.

max_payload_bytes.title: Max Payload Bytes
max_payload_bytes.description: Maximum payload size in bytes to archive per record.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Number of records to batch per write.

batch_ms.title: Batch Ms
batch_ms.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait before flushing a batch.

kafka_retention_days.title: Kafka Retention Days
kafka_retention_days.description: Days the broker keeps records on the Grid queue topics; 0 for unlimited.

schema.title: LogSettingsUpdateRequest
schema.description:
Request body for PUT /api/settings/logs.

All fields are optional — only provided fields are updated (partial update).
The password field accepts plaintext; it will be encrypted on save.
